title: Viral Fever & Clinic Visit
description: A sudden viral fever hit you before mid-terms. Doctor consultation and prescriptions cost you money.

title: Cracked Phone Screen
description: Your phone slipped from your study desk and shattered the display glass. Immediate repair is required for online lecture alerts.

title: Mandatory Lab Manual & Kit Fee
description: Department lab practicals require purchasing the official experiment manual and safety component kit.

title: Hostel TV Short-Circuit Repair
description: A sudden electrical short-circuit in the student residence common room requires shared contribution to fix wiring and fuses.

title: College Semester Activity Fee
description: University portal exam registration and student union activity dues must be cleared before the semester deadline.

title: Reference Library Book Fee
description: Annual institutional library membership and reserve academic reference volumes fee is due for the term.

title: Watch Broken & Strap Repair
description: Your exam timer wristwatch broke during morning commute. Will you repair it or rely on the wall clocks?

choiceA.feedbackMessage: Punctual student! Watch repaired with a 6-month warranty.

choiceB.feedbackMessage: Saved Rs. 450, but hall clocks are sometimes hard to view from back benches.

title: Hometown Friends Visit
description: Childhood friends arrived in town for the weekend and invited you out to celebrate your reunion.

choiceA.feedbackMessage: Wonderful hospitality! Balanced social life builds strong lifelong friendships.

choiceB.feedbackMessage: Fabulous budget hospitality! You saved Rs. 450 and made delicious homemade snacks!

title: Buy Expensive Gift & Attend Party
description: A close batchmate is throwing a major birthday and cultural fest celebration at the city plaza.

choiceA.feedbackMessage: Great celebration! You shared a thoughtful gift and celebrated with friends.

choiceB.feedbackMessage: Heartfelt creativity! Your handmade card was cherished more than shop-bought items!

title: Specialized Financial Accounting Textbook
description: The professor designated an advanced accounting reference textbook as required reading for term tests.

choiceA.feedbackMessage: Crisp new book with digital code access included.

choiceB.feedbackMessage: Savvy student saver! You saved Rs. 400 and received helpful study annotations!

title: Freelance Poster Design Gig
description: A local cafe owner hired you to design promotional flyers and festival social media banners over the weekend!

title: Extra Tutoring Session Bonus
description: You provided math and science coaching to junior school students, and grateful parents handed you a generous performance bonus!

title: Hostel Old Books & Scrap Recycling
description: You cleared out semester scrap, packaging cartons, and old newspapers to the eco-recycling cart.

title: Lost Wallet Returned at Central Library
description: You discovered a professor's lost wallet near the library entrance and promptly handed it to security. They rewarded your honesty!

title: Birthday Cash Gift from Grandpa
description: Your grandfather came to visit your student accommodation and surprised you with a celebration gift!

title: Bicycle Tire Puncture & Tune-Up
description: A nail on Central Avenue flattened your bicycle tire right on your way to afternoon class.

choiceA.feedbackMessage: Immediate repair and brakes tightened for road safety.

choiceB.feedbackMessage: Resourceful mechanic! You patched the tube yourself and saved Rs. 160!
